TANVI JOSHI
Software Engineer · Pune, India
tanvi.joshi.dev@example.com · +91 90000 78901 · github.com/tanvijoshi

SUMMARY
Engineer.

EXPERIENCE

Zenmark Software — Software Engineer                                                   Pune · Aug 2023 – Present
B2B SaaS company (billing software).
- Built the invoice-export service (Python, FastAPI) that generates PDF and CSV exports; export failures dropped from
  4.8% to 0.6%.
- Added Postgres indexes and rewrote 6 queries, cutting the slowest dashboard report from 14 s to 3 s.
- Wrote the team's first integration test suite (86 tests) and wired it into GitHub Actions.

PROJECTS
- bill-splitter — A small web app that splits shared bills between flatmates. FastAPI, SQLite, plain JavaScript.
  github.com/tanvijoshi/bill-splitter

EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Engineering — Sahyadri Institute of Technology, Pune                                   2019 – 2023

SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript (basic)
Backend: FastAPI, REST, PostgreSQL, SQLite
Tooling: GitHub Actions, pytest, Docker, Git
